entries.description: Routed Step 3.5 analysis and authored ai-assignment.md; added in-progress ROADMAP row absorbing harvester-parallel-com-test-cleanup.
Implemented IProcessController seam, SystemProcessController (Process-backed), and the hermetic ComProcessReaper kill-decision logic.

Hardened AccessComSession: early PID capture via hWndAccessApp->GetWindowThreadProcessId (zero-guarded), inner-try Quit(2)/finally FinalReleaseComObject, doubled GC, bounded WaitForExit, exact-PID reaper; shared idempotent TeardownCom for Dispose + constructor-failure.
Routed test-generation for the hermetic ComProcessReaperTests (9 tests: 4 decision cases + null-guard + 3 SystemProcessController ArgumentException paths).

Built AccessHarvester.Tests (0 errors) and ran ONLY the filtered ComProcessReaperTests (9/9 passed); Access-COM/PDF tier deliberately not run. Reaped a pre-existing wedged testhost zombie (PID 8772) via WMI Terminate.
Cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4): round 1 + 2 ISSUES_FOUND (3 Major, all accepted+fixed), round 3 VERIFIED.

Resolved maintainer call (spec Finalization checklist): lock-file (.laccdb/.ldb) cleanup DEFERRED — force-kill is a rare failsafe, samples open read-only and Access auto-recovers a stale .laccdb, no disposable per-run DBs need recreation.

Simplified CliInvoker teardown: replaced the blunt external taskkill /PID /T /F with a narrow managed Process.Kill last-resort on the CLI process only; once required output is stable, let the CLI exit on its own (bounded 15s) so its hardened AccessComSession.Dispose reaps the exact msaccess PID instead of being blunt-killed mid-cleanup. msaccess via COM is DCOM-activated (not in the CLI tree), so a tree-kill never reaped it anyway.

Wired docs/access-com-zombie-cleanup.md into durable guidance: new Testing Convention in project-guidance.md (exact-PID self-cleanup, no by-name taskkill) and a test-lane paragraph in the Building & Testing section of all three agent files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md, keep-in-sync rule).

Fixed a pre-existing parallel-COM file-lock race surfaced by the tier run: added [Collection("HomeHealthCareCom")] to the three Pipeline classes that drive in-process COM against HomeHealthCare.accdb (CanonicalGoldenRegressionTests, EndToEndPipelineTests, ManifestSchemaConformanceTests). Documented fix-forward tactic from project-guidance Testing Conventions. ClassifyCommandTests passed in 7s isolated vs 240s timeout in parallel.

Built solution (0 errors). Hermetic ComProcessReaperTests 9/9 green. Ran the full Access-COM/PDF integration tier (AccessHarvester.Integration) on a Windows host with Access installed: 56/56 passed. Process census msaccess=0/testhost=0 both PRE and POST the run — no surviving msaccess.exe and no leaked testhost created by the run. Swept spurious samples/*.accdb timestamp diffs before staging.
